ai.label: Character Group
ai.description: Invite different characters and models to chat, brainstorm, and compare perspectives.

agent.label: Expert Group
agent.description: Invite experts with clear roles to collaborate on plans, reviews, and conclusions.

cli.label: Dev Group
cli.description: Invite Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, KimiCode, PI, and other dev members to edit code together.

smart.label: Smart pick
smart.description: Pick the most relevant characters based on the message. Good for everyday chat.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Members reply in turn. Good for long-running companion-style conversations.

all.label: Full roundtable
all.description: Every character speaks each round. Good for brainstorming and model comparison.

expert_consult.label: Expert consult
expert_consult.description: Multiple experts analyze the same problem independently, then synthesize a conclusion.

proposal.label: Proposal drafting
proposal.description: Collaborate through research, drafting, review, and finalization.

decision_review.label: Decision review
decision_review.description: Surface benefits, risks, constraints, and a final recommendation from multiple roles.

relay_edit.label: Relay editing
relay_edit.description: One expert drafts, another reviews, and another revises.

auto_delegate.label: Auto delegation
auto_delegate.description: A coordinator delegates across rounds. Good when the goal is clear but steps are not.

quick_response.label: Quick response
quick_response.description: Automatically assign one dev member to handle the current coding task.

implement_review.label: Plan, implement, review
implement_review.description: The planner breaks down the work, the implementer edits code, and review loops until approved.

review_fix.label: Review and fix
review_fix.description: Review existing changes first, then let dev members fix based on feedback.

multi_solution.label: Multiple solutions
multi_solution.description: Multiple dev members handle the same task and show results side by side.

isolated_race.label: Isolated race
isolated_race.description: Dev members implement in parallel worktrees and the user picks the result to adopt.

discussion.label: Read-only discussion
discussion.description: Analyze code plans and risks without requiring file changes.

task.label: Per task
task.description: Each dev task gets its own CLI session. Continuing the same task reuses that session.

workspace.label: Per workspace
workspace.description: All tasks under the same workspace and dev member share one CLI session.

template.label: Per template
template.description: All tasks created from the same team template share one CLI session with the weakest isolation.
